stage: Frozen before the per-anchor/cache/payload runs; after exploratory resolver and grouped-graph inspection. This is an engineering replay protocol, not pristine preregistration or independent semantic ground truth.
scope: Observed exact source and binding identity only. No semantic accuracy, algorithm novelty, downstream task success, or billed-token savings claim.

frozen_samples.selection: Every frozen v1 sample, no replacement or selection using graph outcomes. Original split labels are retained as inherited metadata, not a new independent holdout.

graph.mode: One saved anchor per graph; current whole enclosing declaration is observed independently from original selected chunk.

sequence: cold_before fresh memory cache for each anchor
seed_before shared persistent cache across 30 anchors
warm_before reopened persistent cache across 30 anchors
incremental_after reuse warm_before cache across 30 anchors
cold_after fresh memory cache for each anchor
cache.equivalence: Canonical graph bytes must match cold vs seed/warm and cold vs incremental for every anchor and repetition; lossless field delta must reproduce current graph bytes exactly.
cache.timing_boundary: Source mappings are loaded and verified before timed graph construction; AST cache setup/commit times excluded. Source-I/O and immutable Git-blob savings must be reported separately, not inferred from this parse study.

metrics: full and update rendered UTF-8 bytes
payload.fairness: Aggregate independent per-anchor sessions. Report repeated node/source material and cross-anchor unique source separately. Updates require their identified base; small/incomplete output is not counted as equivalent full delivery.

comparisons: exact selected text via existing v1 source reference
change_attribution: Separate changed enclosing roots from changed descendants behind unchanged roots. A new descendant flag must have an unchanged root fingerprint and changed cause path of at least two nodes. Report absent/unresolved captures and explicit frontier, never relabel them fresh.

historical_extension.selection: For each existing v1 BEFORE commit, take it and its five first-parent ancestors. Freeze actual SHAs and parent links before source extraction and graph outcomes. Read only upstream source; no generated synthetic commit history.
historical_extension.anchors: All original 30 before-version anchors for that repository, reused across all adjacent transitions; unavailable older declarations remain in denominator.
historical_extension.source_scope: Original preregistered library Python prefixes and source exclusion rules.
historical_extension.metrics: Same cold/warm canonical and delta equivalence, parse counts/timings, source-delta file counts. Archive-backed mappings do not measure Git-object-reader transport savings.
